name: @veren/graph-flow-yaml
description: Use when flow definitions live in YAML files and should be loaded into the flow engine at plugin startup: it maps YAML documents to FlowDefinitions (id, nodes, edges, output slot references), validates the shape loudly, registers each flow through ctx.effect for reverse-order unregistration, and reloads on config change; skip it when flows are built in code or stored by @veren/graph-flow-storage.
